title: Blog export
description: Output of scripts/export-blogs.mjs: DynamoDB blog tables reassembled into clean, import-ready blog objects. May aggregate multiple table runs (append mode) — see `sources`. Weekly view-count snapshots are consolidated into a single cumulative analytics.totals per article (individual snapshots are not emitted). There is no publish date in the source tables.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent export run merged into this file.

sources.description: One entry per export run merged into this file (append mode). Blogs are deduped by url across runs.

region.description: AWS region, or null if resolved from the ambient config.

itemsScanned.description: Raw table items read during this run.

blogs.description: Blog objects added/updated by this run.
Total blog objects in this file (across all merged runs).

totals.description: Consolidated cumulative views summed across every exported blog (from each blog's authoritative latest allTime). `total` is the single grand-total value.

blogs.description: One object per catalog entry (canonical article), sorted by url.

tenant.description: Owner of a blog plus its publishing config. Only pk/sk are guaranteed; the rest depend on how the tenant was provisioned.

apiKeyParameter.description: SSM SecureString path holding the tenant's secrets JSON.

slug.description: Article slug (the pk with the leading '/blog/' and any '<tenant>/' segment stripped). Null if it couldn't be derived.

title.description: Article title when available (legacy catalog entries carry it; current-service entries do not). Null when unknown.

canonicalUrl.description: Absolute canonical URL (https://readysetcloud.io<pk>). The sole article identity and the key used to dedupe across merged runs. Null only if the pk was not a string.

tenantId.description: Tenant that owns the article. Derived from GSI1PK ('blog#<tenantId>') or the pk path; the legacy 'allen.helton' is normalized to 'readysetcloud'.

crossposts.description: Consolidated per-platform crosspost record — where this article was cross-posted, with the native URL, post id, and publish status. The import-friendly, authoritative view (url comes from the complete `links` map, falling back to the publish record). A platform key is present only if the article was cross-posted there; an empty object means no crossposts.

publish.description: Publish state from the idempotency record (pk='<tenantId>#<fileName>'). Null when no idempotency record joined to this catalog entry.

totals.description: Consolidated cumulative views for this article, from the latest snapshot's authoritative allTime. `total` is the single per-blog value. Null when the article has no snapshots.

crosspost.description: Native URL, post id, and publish status of one cross-posted copy.

url.description: Native URL of the cross-posted copy on this platform.

id.description: Platform post id of the copy.

status.description: Publish status from the idempotency record, or null if it wasn't tracked.

publisherResult.description: Per-platform publish outcome from the idempotency record. Null if that platform has no entry. May contain only 'status' when in progress or failed.

viewCounts.description: View counts keyed by source. Values are numbers.
